STEP 1: Add page-level animations

Use Framer Motion's <AnimatePresence> and <motion.div> to animate:

a) When the user switches between workflow steps (clicks a step in the vertical stepper), the center content area fades out and slides in the new step content. NOT a hard refresh.

b) When the user clicks "Approve" or any action button, the result reveal animates in (e.g., the Compliance Pre Check results stagger in card by card, not all at once).

c) When the campaign first loads, the hero header animates in (the campaign name fades up, numbers tick up from 0).

d) When the AI drawer opens, it slides in smoothly from the right (use spring animation, not linear).
